Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

phone — a telephone. Example: I have got a new phone.
computer — a machine for storing and using data. Example: We use the computer at home.
laptop — a computer you can carry. Example: I have got a laptop.
tablet — a flat computer with a touch screen. Example: My sister has got a tablet.
camera — a device for taking photos. Example: This is my camera.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I have got a ...
• Have you got a ...?
• It is my phone.
• This is a new laptop.
• I use it every day.
